landing.title: An AI conversation you can branch
landing.description: Research, plan and learn with context-aware branches. Read discussions side by side, find them in the branch tree and bring useful conclusions back to the main thread.
landing.intro: When you research, plan or learn, there is always a detail worth exploring. Branch from a sentence with the context intact, read it beside the main discussion and bring the conclusion back when it is useful.

landing.feature.0.title: Follow up on a sentence, with its context
landing.feature.0.text: When research, design, or learning raises a detail worth exploring, open a branch. It inherits the preceding context at creation time, so you do not have to explain it again. Explore the details while the main thread moves forward.
landing.feature.0.sample: What supports this conclusion? Are there alternatives?
landing.feature.1.title: Read side by side and compare the details
landing.feature.1.text: Keep the main thread and its branches in adjacent columns. Read long explanations, tables, and code while the original question stays in view. Compare assumptions, evidence, and alternatives as you go.
landing.feature.1.sample: Keep the original question in view while clarifying the details.
landing.feature.2.title: Find every question in the branch tree
landing.feature.2.text: Follow-up questions naturally form branches. Use the branch tree and child-thread navigation to retrace a discussion. Collapse branches you are not using and reopen them when needed.
landing.feature.2.sample: Keep many discussions, but only the ones you need in view.
landing.feature.3.title: Bring useful conclusions back to your work
landing.feature.3.text: Save a branch conclusion as an Artifact and explicitly reference it with @ in the main thread. Choose what to carry forward into your requirements, research report, or learning plan.
landing.feature.3.sample: Explore → choose a conclusion → return to the main thread.
landing.faq.0.question: Why build ThreadChat when there are already so many AI products?
landing.faq.0.answer: Complex questions rarely follow a single straight line. You explore concepts, compare options, and check evidence. ThreadChat lets those discussions develop independently while preserving their origins. Read them side by side, navigate back through the branch tree, and bring useful conclusions into your work.
landing.faq.1.question: How is it different from a whiteboard or mind map?
landing.faq.1.answer: Whiteboards and mind maps organize information and relationships. ThreadChat focuses on sustained discussion: columns hold complete conversations, a branch tree supports navigation, and explicit references bring conclusions back. It is designed for reading long explanations, comparing evidence, and working through options.
landing.faq.2.question: What can I use it for?
landing.faq.2.answer: Use it for complex tasks that involve several follow-up questions and a final conclusion. Check evidence during research, compare choices and boundaries in a PRD or technical plan, or explore unfamiliar AI and finance concepts before returning to your learning path.
landing.faq.3.question: Will I lose track as branches grow?
landing.faq.3.answer: The branch tree preserves where discussions came from. Thread counts and child-branch navigation help you locate them. Collapse branches you are not reading and reopen them later; you do not have to keep everything on screen.
landing.faq.4.question: Do I have to arrange nodes or maintain a tree?
landing.faq.4.answer: No. You do not need to draw a structure or position nodes before asking questions. The origin is recorded when you branch from a sentence. Use the tree when you need to revisit or switch discussions.
landing.faq.5.question: Do branch discussions affect the main thread?
landing.faq.5.answer: New branch messages do not automatically enter the main thread’s context. Save a useful conclusion as an Artifact and explicitly reference it with @ when you return. You decide what enters the next discussion.
landing.faq.6.question: Will an existing branch change if I edit the main thread?
landing.faq.6.answer: Not automatically. A branch keeps the context inherited at creation time and develops independently afterward.
landing.faq.7.question: Do I need to prepare a complete question first?
landing.faq.7.answer: No. Start with what you want to do, then follow up on anything interesting or unclear in the reply.
landing.faq.8.question: How do I get started?
landing.faq.8.answer: Choose ‘Get started’ and follow the sign-in or registration instructions. You can also explore the scenarios on this page to try branching and referencing conclusions.
